title: automate-tenant-rbac-bootstrap-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add automation for tenant RBAC bootstrap in Private installer: Helm templates, Terraform module, installer hook, and e2e tests. Backwards compatible.
description: Motivation: Private deployments require an automated, idempotent RBAC bootstrap path to create tenant-scoped roles and service accounts during installer runs (VPC/on-prem flow). This PR adds a dedicated terraform module and Helm templates plus an installer hook to wire tenant-role bootstrapping into the private-installer flow. It addresses gaps discovered during recent on-prem pilots where manual role wiring caused delays and misconfigurations. Changes include: terraform module for rbac-bootstrap, Helm role and rolebinding templates scoped by Tenant CR, installer automation script with retries and idempotency, CI checks and e2e test coverage, and docs/upgrade notes. Checklist: [x] terraform module scaffolded [x] helm templates added [x] installer hook implemented [x] idempotency + retries added [x] unit + e2e tests [x] docs updated. Related: Linear ENG-4821, ENG-4988. See docs/upgrade_notes/tenant-rbac-bootstrap.md for upgrade instructions and rollback notes.

notes: Idempotency: bootstrap_rbac.sh stores a bootstrap annotation on Tenant CR to mark completion.
Rollback: installer will skip role creation if annotation exists; remove annotation to force re-run.
Compatibility: module exports role names and bindings to allow downstream modules to reference generated principals.
